description: 한국도로공사_노선별 월 변동계수 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국도로공사. 본 데이터는 고속도로 노선별 월간 교통량의 변동 특성을 수치화하여 제공하는 공공자료이다. 한국도로공사에서 관리하며, 도로명, 월별, 구간 등의 항목으로 구성되어 있다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국도로공사. Its tags are 통행속도, 주행거리, 월 변동계수, 교통패턴, 도로운영. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
